jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Spring Boot)
jobs.description: CloudScale is seeking a talented Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong production experience in React, TypeScript, Java 21, and Spring Boot 3. You will design, build, and deploy high-concurrency microservices on Azure AKS.
requirements: 5+ years of software development experience using Java / Spring Boot and React / TypeScript
Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and JPA / Hibernate
Hands-on expertise deploying containerized services on Docker and Kubernetes (AKS)
Understanding of 3-tier enterprise cloud architectures, JWT authentication, and REST APIs
Familiarity with CI/CD deployment pipelines using Jenkins or GitHub Actions
benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible hybrid schedule with remote Fridays

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Platform & DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a seasoned DevOps / Cloud Engineer to manage immutable VMSS deployments using Packer, Ansible, and Terraform. You will spearhead our zero-downtime rolling upgrades and manage Jenkins CI/CD automation.
requirements: Strong expertise with Microsoft Azure IaaS (VM Scale Sets, App Gateway WAF, Virtual Networks)
Extensive experience writing Terraform IaC and Packer golden image baking templates
Familiarity with Ansible playbook roles and CIS hardening standards
Hands-on experience configuring Jenkins with Configuration as Code (JCasC)
Knowledge of Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Prometheus/Grafana dashboards

jobs.title: AI Applied Scientist / ML Engineer
jobs.description: Work with our AI Research team building document cognitive extraction pipelines using Azure AI Document Intelligence, embeddings, and customized LLM models for automated resume and unstructured text parsing.
requirements: B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field
Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, and FastAPI
Experience with Azure AI services (Cognitive Services / Document Intelligence)
Solid foundation in NLP, vector databases, and similarity ranking algorithms
benefits: Generous stock options in rapid-growth AI company
Onsite chef and gym membership in downtown Austin office
Annual equipment refresh (M3 Max MacBook Pro)

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (React + TypeScript)
jobs.description: Create lightning-fast analytics dashboards with React 19, TypeScript, and modern component systems. Prior experience with financial charts and real-time websockets is a huge plus.
requirements: 3+ years of professional React experience
Strong TypeScript skills and state management proficiency
Experience with Tailwind CSS and accessible UI design

jobs.title: Lead Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: Lead enterprise security hardening across multi-region Azure infrastructure. Oversee CIS benchmarks, OpenSCAP image scans, Application Gateway WAF rules, and Defender for Cloud configurations.
requirements: 7+ years experience in cybersecurity operations and cloud security architecture
Certifications such as CISSP, Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500) highly regarded
Hands-on experience with WAF tuning, OWASP Top 10 mitigation, and identity governance
